events.title: Let's prepare the greenhouse!
events.description: Your crew has arrived on Mars. Should you plant the first crops now, or save power and water for other jobs?
events.scienceFact: Plants need water, light, and nutrients to grow. A greenhouse helps give plants the conditions they need.

choices.label: Start growing food
choices.description: Plant the first crops. This uses power and water.
choices.explanation: Your crops are growing. They need time before they are ready to harvest.

choices.label: Save power and water
choices.description: Keep your supplies for other important outpost jobs.
choices.explanation: You saved your supplies, but no food is growing in the greenhouse yet.

events.title: Dust is covering our solar panels!
events.description: A dust storm has left dust on the solar panels. Dusty panels make less electricity for the outpost.
events.scienceFact: Mars can have huge dust storms. Dust on a solar panel can block sunlight and lower the electricity it makes.

choices.label: Clean the solar panels
choices.description: Use 5 power units to clean the panels. They can make more electricity again.
choices.explanation: The panels are clean. They can now make more electricity each Sol.

choices.label: Keep our power
choices.description: Save your electricity for other important equipment.
choices.explanation: You kept your power, but the dusty panels will keep making less electricity.

events.title: The rover found an interesting rock!
events.description: Your robot rover has found a rock that scientists would like to study. You can collect a sample or save power.
events.scienceFact: By studying Martian rocks, scientists learn how Mars changed over time and what the planet was like long ago.

choices.label: Collect a rock sample
choices.description: Use 8 power units to study the rock and finish the rock research.
choices.explanation: Great work! Your crew has finished its rock research.

choices.label: Save our power
choices.description: Wait before studying the rock and keep the electricity for later.
choices.explanation: You saved power, but the rock research is not finished.

events.title: Space radiation warning!
events.description: Mission Control has sent a warning about space radiation. Your crew can add extra protection to the shelter or save the water.
events.scienceFact: Space radiation is energy that travels through space. Too much can harm astronauts. Special shielding can help protect them.

choices.label: Add water to the shelter
choices.description: In this game, set aside 5 water units to add basic shielding.
choices.explanation: Your shelter now has basic extra shielding. It lowers the game's radiation-risk points.

choices.label: Save the water
choices.description: Keep the water for the crew's normal needs.
choices.explanation: You kept the water, but the shelter has no extra shielding for this warning.

events.title: The habitat's air system has stopped!
events.description: The machine that helps keep the habitat's air safe is not working. Fix it now, or use backup mode for one Sol.
events.scienceFact: People need clean air to breathe. A Mars habitat needs machines to provide and manage safe air for the crew.

choices.label: Fix the air system
choices.description: Use 6 power units to repair the habitat's air system.
choices.explanation: The air system is working again. The crew can breathe safely inside the habitat.

choices.label: Use backup mode
choices.description: Save power for now, but remember the air system still needs to be fixed soon.
choices.explanation: Backup mode gives the crew a little time. Fix the air system before another Sol passes.

events.title: Should we grow more food?
events.description: The crew can start another crop cycle or save supplies. If the habitat's air system is still broken, fixing it is also important.
events.scienceFact: Growing food on Mars takes planning. Plants need water, power, light, and time before they are ready to harvest.

choices.label: Fix the air system
choices.description: Use 6 power units to restore the habitat's air system.
choices.explanation: You repaired the habitat. The crew can use its air system again.

choices.label: Grow another batch of food
choices.description: Start another crop cycle. It uses 5 power units and 5 water units.
choices.explanation: New crops are growing. They need two Sols before harvest. Make sure the air system is working too.

events.title: One last science mission!
events.description: Before the seven-Sol mission ends, your crew has one last chance to study the land and conditions around the outpost.
events.scienceFact: Scientists study Mars's air, weather, soil, and radiation to understand what future explorers may face.

choices.label: Study Mars's environment
choices.description: Use 8 power units to finish the environmental research.
choices.explanation: Excellent work! Your crew has finished its study of the Martian environment.

choices.label: Save our remaining power
choices.description: Keep your electricity for the outpost instead of doing the final study.
choices.explanation: You saved power, but the environmental study is not finished.
